Perks › Legendary

Sovereign Draw

Legendary perk · Boneyard

Every boneyard visit draws one extra face-down candidate per stack; reveal them and choose what to keep.

In-game card text

How it works

On every boneyard visit you pick one extra face-down bone for each copy. All of them are turned over and you choose which to keep. The rest stay in the boneyard.

  • It stacks with Dead Man's Draw and Light Fingers.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeBoneyard
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Draw 150 bones; Visit the boneyard 75 times; Win 10 blocked hands), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
